Chapter I
The Diamond
Long before a promise is spoken, pressure and time create its brightest symbol.
2.14carats
An oval diamond is selected for balance, fire and the distinct character of its natural inclusions.
Selection 03

Light study

Every facet and inclusion is mapped under cold light, revealing the diamond’s individual character before the ring is drawn.

The beauty of a diamond ring begins with knowing every hand, place and decision behind it.

A transparent chain of custody gives the ring a complete biography—from the diamond’s origin to the bench where platinum becomes its permanent frame.

The centre stone receives a unique light signature. Its grading, provenance and design record remain permanently connected to the finished ring.

Every choice is visible: diamond, recycled platinum, setting method and the hands responsible for its final polish.
